text.en: This Order may be cited as the Employment {Amendment) Order, 2014. of section 123 of S 37/2009.

Section 123 of the Employment Order, 2009 is amended by deleting "$1,600" from the second line and by substituting "$3,000" therefor. 6t~. day of Sya'aban, 1435 Hijriah corresponding to the 4th. day of June, 2014 at Our Istana Nurul Iman, Bandar Seri Begawan, Brunei Darussalam.

THE SULTAN AND YANG DI-PERTUAN

BRUNEI DARUSSALAM
